sourceRefs.locator: Exhibition introduction, 1964 discovery of celadon tiles, 1964–1977 excavations, kiln structures, equipment, court supply and over 100,000 finds.
Paragraphs on glaze, Gangjin and Buan, the flowering of production in the twelfth century and the technique of clay inlay.
Accession Jeung2344. Goryosa account of the Yangijeong pavilion in 1157, distinguished from the surviving comparison tile.

note.de: In den Werkstätten bei Gangjin entstehen Seladongefäße und glasierte Dachziegel. Über die Arbeit gibt die Keramik aus den Ausgrabungen Auskunft. Einzelne Ziegel lassen sich keinem Baujahr zuweisen.
note.en: The kilns near Gangjin produce celadon vessels and glazed roof tiles. Excavated ceramics preserve evidence of the work. No particular year of manufacture can be assigned to an individual tile.
